model_selection: Highest mean development fold ROC-AUC; no holdout-dependent tuning
preprocessing: Fold-local median/missing indicators and one-hot; standardization for logistic; deterministic row-wise feature engineering
final_validation: One selected configuration fitted on development, then one holdout evaluation with 1000-draw stratified fixed-prediction bootstrap
comparisons: Pre-specified paired development-fold differences: tree vs linear, derived features, external scores, bureau history
interpretation_limits: Fold SD is not a confidence interval
